requirement: A recent health certificate is mandatory for every guest before Kawah Ijen crater entry, per BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024.
workflow: Nurse or medical staff visits the guest hotel before the Ijen hike.
Vitals are checked at the accommodation.
BSrE-signed digital certificate is issued for cleared guests.
Certificate is checked at Paltuding trailhead before crater-zone access.
screeningLocations: hotel or JVTO office mobile session
notClearedOutcome: The climb is cancelled for that individual, not the group; alternatives include base camp or safe viewpoint waiting.
riskBoundary: Screening is a pre-hike assessment, not a guarantee of safe hike conditions.
